head: working-tree
subject: MQTT topic-name validation combines ASCII and wildcard checks
change: validTopicName previously ran the MQTT UTF-8 validator and then a separate wildcard search over every topic name. It now checks sixteen-byte ASCII chunks once for high bytes, NUL, '+' and '#'. A chunk containing a high byte falls back to the full UTF-8 validator plus the wildcard search, so mixed/non-ASCII names keep their exact rules; pure ASCII names need one vector pass and a short tail.

mqtt_interop.note: full Mosquitto-derived broker configuration matrix, including Client ID bounds, topic filters, ACL reloads and retained/shared delivery

notes: The tail-slot churn workload enqueues a QoS 1 publish per iteration through the public Session API, which validates the topic name. The combined pass preserves the length bound, NUL rejection, wildcard rejection and the general UTF-8/noncharacter rules for non-ASCII names.
